title: Cartwright--Sturmfelsness of complementary determinantal edge ideals
summary: We introduce complementary determinantal edge ideals. For a graph $G$ on $n$ vertices, the complementary determinantal edge ideal $J_{c}(G)$ is generated by the maximal minors of a generic $(n-2)\times n$ matrix obtained by deleting the two columns indexed by each edge of $G$. We completely characterize the graphs for which $J_{c}(G)$ is Cartwright--Sturmfels with respect to the grading by columns.
